name: web-perspective-dot-grid-field-on-black
title: Black plane of tiny white dots in perspective, waving gently toward the horizon
whatItIs: A pure black canvas covered by a receding grid of tiny grey-white dots that ripples like a fabric sheet, dense near the horizon and sparse at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Quiet and spatial; the dot plane gives depth without any imagery.
techniques: Lay a dot grid in perspective.
Ripple it with a soft wave.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of dots laid in perspective.
Many small points forming a texture.
A ripple moving through a grid.
